name: linkedin-jobs-mcp-server
description: Search and inspect LinkedIn jobs through your own signed-in browser session
long_description:
# LinkedIn Jobs MCP Server

> Independent open-source project. Not affiliated with LinkedIn or Microsoft. LinkedIn is a trademark of LinkedIn Corporation.

A jobs-focused MCP server derived from [stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server). It searches postings, reads job details, inspects application methods and Easy Apply forms, lists jobs in the user's tracker, and dismisses unwanted postings.

The server reads LinkedIn through the user's own browser session. Session data remains on the local machine.

author.name: Daniel Sticker and LinkedIn Jobs MCP Server contributors

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search LinkedIn jobs by keyword, location, recency, job type, experience level, work type, Easy Apply and sort order

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Read a LinkedIn job posting's description, requirements and company details using its job ID

tools.name: get_job_apply_url
tools.description: Read how a job takes applications and return the employer's application URL when available

tools.name: get_easy_apply_form
tools.description: Read an Easy Apply form's questions and prefilled values without submitting or keeping a draft

tools.name: get_saved_jobs
tools.description: List saved, in-progress, applied or archived jobs from the authenticated user's LinkedIn job tracker

tools.name: dismiss_job
tools.description: Dismiss an unwanted job from LinkedIn search; this action is irreversible

tools.name: get_session_status
tools.description: Inspect local saved-session and browser-serving state without contacting LinkedIn

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Close the browser session without deleting the saved LinkedIn login

chrome_path.title: Chrome executable
chrome_path.description: Optional path to a Chrome, Chromium or Chrome for Testing executable instead of the bundled browser.

proxy_server.title: Proxy server
proxy_server.description: Optional browser-only proxy as scheme://host:port. Credentials may be included for HTTP(S) proxies.

proxy_bypass.title: Proxy bypass list
proxy_bypass.description: Optional comma-separated hosts to reach directly instead of through the proxy.
